title: UltraElevators
description: The best elevator plugin to move between different heights.
body:

<details>
<summary>Text Transcrip</summary>

With UltraElevators, you can create elevators out of any block type to let players teleport between different levels, allowing you to configure sounds, messages, particles, and much more.
Compatible with WorldGuard and other protection plugins through its custom use flag.

COMMANDS:
- /ue give <player> <type> - Give a specific elevator item to a player.
- /ue reload - Reload the plugin configuration and guide.

PERMISSIONS:
- ultraelevators.admin - Access to all commands and administrative features.
- ultraelevators.limit.<number> - Set a maximum number of elevators for a player.
- ultraelevators.limit.* - Allow a player to place an infinite number of elevators.

WORLDGUARD FLAG:
- ultra-elevators - Set to 'deny' in a region to prevent elevator usage.

INTERNAL PLACEHOLDERS:
- %limit% - Shows the maximum number of elevators allowed.
- %placed% - Shows the current number of elevators the player has placed.
- %cooldown% - Shows the remaining cooldown time for teleportation.
- %type_name% - Shows the display name of the elevator type.
- %type% - Shows the technical ID of the elevator type.
- %page% - Current page number in the customization GUI.
- %material% - Name of the material being displayed in the GUI.

</details>
